1.statement: SELECT [Tabelle1].[Spalte1 Typ Int], [Tabelle1].[Spalte2] FROM [Tabelle1] WHERE [Tabelle1].[Spalte1] > (SELECT AVG([Tabelle1].[Spalte1]));

2.statement: SELECT [Tabelle1].[Spalte1], [Tabelle1].[Spalte2] FROM [Tabelle1] WHERE [Tabelle1].[Tabelle2 ID] IN (SELECT [Tabelle2].[Tabelle2 ID] FROM [Tabelle2]);

3.statement: SELECT [Tabelle1].[Spalte1], [Tabelle1].[Spalte2], (SELECT count(*) AS [NeuerName1] FROM [Tabelle2] WHERE [Tabelle1].[Tabelle1 ID] = [Tabelle2].[Tabelle1 ID]) FROM [Tabelle1];

4.statement: SELECT [Tabelle1].[Spalte1], [Tabelle1].[Spalte2] FROM [Tabelle1] WHERE EXISTS (SELECT * FROM [Tabelle2] WHERE [Tabelle2].[Tabelle1 ID] = [Tabelle1].[Tabelle1 ID];

5.statement: SELECT [Tabelle1].[Spalte1], [Tabelle1].[Spalte2], [NeuerName1].[Spalte3] FROM [Tabelle1] JOIN (SELECT [Tabelle1].[Tabelle1 ID], SUM([NeuerName1]) AS [Tabelle2] FROM [Tabelle2] GROUP BY [Tabelle2].[Tabelle1 ID]) AS [NeuerName1] ON [Tabelle1].[Tabelle1 ID] = [NeuerName1].[Tabelle1 ID];

8.statement: SELECT [Tabelle1].[Spalte1] FROM [Tabelle1] WHERE [Tabelle1].[Tabelle2 ID] NOT IN (SELECT [Tabelle2].[Tabelle2 ID] FROM [Tabelle2] WHERE [Tabelle2].[Spalte2] = [String]);

9.statement: SELECT [Tabelle1].[Spalte1] FROM [Tabelle1] WHERE (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM [Tabelle2] WHERE [Tabelle2].[Tabelle1 ID] = [Tabelle1].[Tabelle1 ID]) > [Int];

10.statement: SELECT [Tabelle1].[Spalte1], (SELECT [Tabelle2].[Spalte1] FROM [Tabelle2] WHERE [Tabelle2].[Tabelle2 ID] = [Tabelle1].[Tabelle2 ID]) AS [Name] FROM [Tabelle1];

11.statement: SELECT * FROM (SELECT [Tabelle1].[Spalte1], [Tabelle1].[Spalte2] FROM [Tabelle1] WHERE [Tabelle1].[Spalte1] > [Int]) AS [TempTabelle] WHERE [TempTabelle].[Spalte2] LIKE '[Buchstabe]%';

12.statement: SELECT [Tabelle1].[Spalte1] FROM [Tabelle1] WHERE [Tabelle1].[Spalte1] > ALL (SELECT [Tabelle2].[Spalte1] FROM [Tabelle2] WHERE [Tabelle2].[Spalte2] = [String]);

13.statement: UPDATE [Tabelle1] SET [Tabelle1].[Spalte1] = [Tabelle1].[Spalte1] * 1.1 WHERE [Tabelle1].[Tabelle1 ID] IN (SELECT [Tabelle2].[Tabelle1 ID] FROM [Tabelle2] WHERE [Tabelle2].[Spalte2] = [String]);

14.statement: SELECT [Tabelle1].[Spalte1] FROM [Tabelle1] WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM [Tabelle2] WHERE [Tabelle2].[Tabelle1 ID] = [Tabelle1].[Tabelle1 ID]);

15.statement: SELECT [Tabelle1].[Spalte1], [Tabelle1].[Spalte2] FROM [Tabelle1] WHERE [Tabelle1].[Spalte1] > (SELECT AVG([NeuerName1].[Spalte1]) FROM [Tabelle1] AS [NeuerName1] WHERE [NeuerName1].[Tabelle1 ID] = [Tabelle1].[Tabelle1 ID]);
